print("Num edges:", len(edges))
# Validate all u<v<22

    assert 0<=u<v<n
# No duplicates
assert len(set(edges))==len(edges)

adj=[set() for _ in range(n)]
for u,v in edges:
    adj[u].add(v); adj[v].add(u)

# Girth via BFS
def girth(adj):
    g=999
    for src in range(n):
        dist=[-1]*n; par=[-1]*n
        dist[src]=0; q=[src]
        while q:
            nq=[]
            for u in q:
                for v in adj[u]:
                    if dist[v]==-1:
                        dist[v]=dist[u]+1; par[v]=u; nq.append(v)
                    elif par[u]!=v:
                        cl=dist[u]+dist[v]+1
                        if cl<g: g=cl
            q=nq
    return g
print("Girth:", girth(adj))

# 3-coloring
color=[-1]*n
order = sorted(range(n), key=lambda x:-len(adj[x]))
def bt(i):
    if i==n: return True
    v=order[i]
    used=set(color[u] for u in adj[v] if color[u]!=-1)
    for c in range(3):
        if c not in used:
            color[v]=c
            if bt(i+1): return True
            color[v]=-1
    return False
print("3-colorable:", bt(0))
